name: Zebrium

hlido_opinion.headline: Zebrium shows signs of decline — lacks recent updates and clarity on core functionality.
hlido_opinion.body: Zebrium has not made significant updates or improvements in its offering, which raises concerns about its viability in a rapidly evolving evaluation landscape. The absence of clear information on its core functionalities and the lack of recent user feedback suggest that it may not be keeping pace with competitors. While it may still serve existing users, potential new users should approach with caution, as the fading status indicates a risk of obsolescence. Without a clear direction or innovation, Zebrium is at risk of being overshadowed by more active players in the evaluation space.

tier_rationale: FADING (65) due to the lack of updates and clarity on functionality, suggesting it may not be a reliable choice for new users. A shift to STEADY would require renewed activity or clear communication of its value proposition.
